reference_host: eight-GPU RTX 4090 D, 24 GB per card, eight concurrent shards
statistic: median of per-epoch time_s across all landed epochs of the longest attempt
note: Measured from landed train.log files on the reference host, including unaccepted staging attempts. sttn, dgcrn and d2stgnn were measured under the 24 GB microbatch adapter and should drop on a 32 GB card at native batch 32. dgcrn and d2stgnn medians rest on very few epochs, so treat them as coarse. stgcn never started on the reference host and hl is analytic; both carry explicit estimates.
region_scale_basis: nodes multiplied by train sample count, normalized to Orange: Alameda 521 by 32001, ContraCosta 496 by 16414, Orange 990 by 42372
